purpose: Teach: 歌唱/夏季/航行/美的/現世/国防総省/パルス/生産物

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、合唱の歌唱法研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered choir singing technique in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle, curious, conversational. Soft opening. The tone of checking in with a student you respect — warm but professional.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、夏季オリンピックの経済効果を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually wrote about the economic impact of the Summer Olympics.
lines.style: Direct, honest correction. No defensiveness. A student being precise about her own work. Clear, steady pace.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近世の航行技術史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And medieval navigation history was your topic, then?
lines.style: Light, thoughtful. A beat of recognition. Still checking — not testing, just confirming. Warm curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、現代芸術の美的価値を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — I wrote about the aesthetic value of contemporary art instead.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact correction. Patient. She's used to this kind of exchange. No edge to it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 現世利益の宗教研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So you covered religious research on worldly benefits, yes?
lines.style: Engaged, present. She's listening carefully. A genuine question, not a test. Slight lift at the end — openness to being corrected again.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、国防総省と日本外交を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, my paper was on the U.S. Department of Defense and Japanese diplomacy.
lines.style: Steady, clear. A third correction delivered without impatience. She knows she's being listened to. Direct but not clipped.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 神経のパルス信号を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Nerve impulse signals in your research — is that right?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective. A slight smile in the voice. She knows she's getting it wrong. It's not quite earnest now — it's become almost playful.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、農業生産物の流通史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, I wrote about the distribution history of agricultural products.
lines.style: Final correction, delivered warmly. She's smiling now too — complicit in the rhythm of this exchange. Closing, satisfied.
